findings.finding: Two extended JLC parts (J1 C492401, D1 C12624): an extended-part loading fee each on a 5-board order. No basic 0603 green LED was found: live parts_search for C72043 (Everlight 19-217/GHC-YR1S2/3T) returns basic=False, stock 0; basic-only 0603 green search returns 0 rows.
findings.evidence: parts/parts.json basic=false for C492401 and C12624; parts_search.py live 2026-10-29.
findings.fix: Accept (brief says basic 'wherever one fits'); or hand-solder J1 and drop it from the PCBA BOM.

findings.finding: KENTO numbers the LED pins 1 = anode (+), 2 = cathode (green corner mark at the pin-2 end); the EasyEDA C12624 symbol/footprint and this board number pad 1 = K. The board is right by role (pad 1 K on GND, pad 2 A on /LED_A, silk triangle and chamfer at pad 1), but any pin-number compare against the KENTO drawing reads reversed.
findings.evidence: KENTO KT-0603G spec for approval rev A.0 (2018-12-06) p.2 package drawing (symbol: pin 1 '+', bar at pin 2; green mark at pin-2 end). EasyEDA C12624 (cpl_verify cache 2026-10-29): symbol pin 1 'K' -> footprint pad 1. Netlist: D1 pin1 K on GND, pin2 A on /LED_A. Board: D1 at (18,19.8) rot 90, pad1 (18,20.55) GND, pad2 (18,19.05) /LED_A.
findings.fix: None; check the cathode mark in JLC's DFM placement preview at order (known unknown).

findings.finding: The three 0603 lands are the generic LCSC/EasyEDA patterns, slightly larger than the makers' recommendations: C1 pad width 0.90 mm vs Samsung 2/3W < b < W (0.53-0.80 mm); R1 0.806x0.864 at 1.5 pitch (outer 2.31 mm) vs UNI-ROYAL 0603 land D = 2.1 mm, C = 0.8 mm; D1 0.8x0.8 at 1.5 pitch (outer 2.3 mm, gap 0.7) vs KENTO 0.70 pad / 0.70 gap (outer 2.1 mm). All overlap the terminations fully; no assembly risk at 0603.
findings.evidence: Board pads (kicad_pcb): C1 0.8x0.9 @ +-0.7; R1 0.806x0.864 @ +-0.75; D1 0.8x0.8 @ +-0.75. Samsung MLCC catalog land guidance; UNI-ROYAL ds sec.8 0603 A0.9/B0.65/C0.8/D2.1; KENTO KT-0603G spec for approval rev A.0 (2018-12-06) p.2 suggested pad.
findings.margin: outer length +0.2 mm (+10%) over maker lands; D1 gap 0.70 = 0.70 recommended

findings.finding: D1's library symbol is named/valued '0603 Green 509-620mcd' while the placed part is KT-0603G (IV 210-430 mcd typ range, bins P24-P28 up to 520 mcd). Instance fields (MPN, LCSC C12624, value KT-0603G) are right; the lib metadata is stale.
findings.evidence: Netlist libpart 0603Green509-620mcd, value field '0603 Green 509-620mcd'; KENTO KT-0603G spec for approval rev A.0 (2018-12-06) p.3 IV 210-430 mcd @5 mA, p.4 bins.
